# Mpho Musketeers website

Static GitHub Pages-ready website for Mpho Musketeers. Open `index.html` locally or publish the repository as a GitHub Pages site.

The site uses the supplied Mpho Musketeers logo, Dezemba campaign posters, product images, and event imagery. Contact actions use WhatsApp `076 140 1115` and `mphomakabe2@gmail.com`.
